caps_evidence.statement: No public hard caps or numerical quotas for quantum, online algorithms, or other areas were found in either official 2026 CFP, the conference homepage, or program; targeted public searches also found no authoritative cap policy. This is an absence-of-documentation finding, not proof that the PC used no internal balancing judgments.
caps_evidence.positive_policy_evidence: The CFP says the topics are non-exclusive and that the PC will make every effort to consider a broad range of areas.
caps_evidence.exact_quote: The program committee will make every effort to consider a broad range of areas.
caps_evidence.unrelated_numeric_cap: The CFP permits up to three Best Paper awards; that is an award cap, not an acceptance/topic cap.
